summary: Mars-terclass: a 2D top-down puzzle game. Solve mini-games built on real NASA data (DONKI, NeoWs, Perseverance, EPIC) to restore four logs and piece together a colony's story.
details:
Mars-terclass is a 2D pixel-art educational game built for the challenge "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer."

The problem: realistic astronaut mission training rarely reaches young people, space and Mars conditions are hard to grasp from theory alone, and static learning content fails to engage the new generation.

Our solution: there is no character to control. Each mission opens with a short space story, the player solves it through an interactive mini-game, and every mission teaches a real scientific fact. The game currently includes four story mini-games: Solar Storm Shelter (solar storm risks and protection), Meteor Radar (tracking meteoroid threats), Crater Lakes (ancient lake beds on Mars) and Connection to the World (Mars-Earth communication delay).

NASA data: the game uses real NASA data and fetches it live through NASA Open APIs, including Mars weather data. The data is requested from within the game using GDScript, and it changes the conditions and difficulty of the mini-games.

Results: Mars-terclass is a working, playable game today, with four story mini-games, four science topics and a live NASA data connection.

Impact: students, astronaut candidates and space enthusiasts can learn by playing, with scientific accuracy.
